summary: Wayne Phillips of Montrose, a duck hunter last seen about three weeks before Jan 11, 2023 (mid-December 2022); Delta County Sheriff's Office and multiple assisting agencies conducted an extended search. Over the Feb 25-26, 2023 weekend a fisherman in the Gunnison Gorge National Conservation Area found a body in the river; deputies responded and the Delta County Coroner's Office assisted with the recovery; autopsy identified the deceased as Phillips.
location: Gunnison Gorge National Conservation Area, Gunnison River
responding_agency: Delta County Sheriff's Office; Delta County Coroner's Office
notes: Date approximate — body found 'over the weekend' per the 2023-03-01 KVNF newscast (i.e., Feb 25-26, 2023); missing since ~2022-12-20. Search-phase detail from the 2023-01-11 KVNF newscast (citing the Montrose Daily Press); recovery detail from the 2023-03-01 KVNF newscast (citing the Delta County Independent). First indexed Delta County 2022-2023 duck-hunter fatality.
